summary: PR successfully implements time-bounded HMAC token signing and verification with constant-time comparison, preserving all existing behavior and passing all tests.
key_findings: Req 1: sign_Path_token correctly generates lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 digest over f'{path}:{int(expires_at)}'
Req 2: verify_Path_token checks now <= expires_at and uses hmac.compare_digest for constant-time equality
All existing tests pass including legacy expiry_remaining test
Diff shows exactly 2 files changed with 20 insertions and 1 deletion as required
